name: C-Psych Fit Check

P_E.label: Extraversion
P_E.source: IPIP-50 Big-Five Factor Markers (Goldberg, 1992); public domain

CP_clan.label: Prefers Clan (collaborate)
CP_clan.source: provisional; Competing Values Framework constructs (Quinn & Rohrbaugh, 1983)

personality.title: How you see yourself
personality.intro: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of roughly your age. Your answers stay confidential.

motives.title: What motivates you at work
motives.intro: How much do you agree with each statement about what matters to you at work?

style.title: Your working style and preferred culture
style.intro: How much do you agree with each statement about how you like to work?

pressure.title: You under pressure
pressure.intro: Think about times when you were under heavy pressure, tired or stressed at work. How much do you agree with each statement?

org.title: Your organisation's culture
org.intro: Describe the organisation as it actually is day to day, not as it is described officially (unless a statement asks about what leadership says).

team.title: Your team's culture
team.intro: Describe the team you work in (or would join) as it actually works day to day.

criteria.title: Your experience at work
criteria.intro: These questions help us test whether the fit model predicts real experience. There are no right answers.
